title: SourceCandidate
description: One discovered source under evaluation — a CANDIDATE to become an authoritative input to a SourceRecipe, not yet trusted. It REQUIRES a source_handle (the opaque, content-addressable reference; a candidate without a handle cannot be stored or cited) and an authority_rank (the comparative authority used by reliability scoring + reconciliation: source-of-law outranks an agency FAQ). It is a proposal: it does not carry facts, only the locator + authority signals. Deterministic when discovered_at is injected.

candidate_id.description: content-addressed over (source_handle, scope); version in metadata, never in the id

source_handle.description: REQUIRED — opaque content-addressable handle to the source (e.g. ctx://public/source/ecfr/12-CFR-1005.11); a candidate without a handle is rejected

source_type.description: the kind of source (drives default authority + reconciliation precedence)

authority_rank.description: REQUIRED — comparative authority (higher outranks lower); reconciliation uses this so a FAQ can never outrank a regulation

access_method.description: how the source is reached; in the lean core fixtures back the golden path

officialness.description: is this the source-of-record or a restatement of it

discovered_by.description: the agent id that surfaced this candidate
